findings.detail: The four text-pathway rates were sourced from the December 31 comparative schedule rather than the March 31 current-period schedule.

rationale: The filing separates the March 31, 2026 schedule in tables 8-14 from the December 31, 2025 comparative schedule in tables 32-38. Exact-value searches place 11.08, 8.22, and 1.75 only in comparative tables 35-37. At issuer level, TM Restaurant has 11.08 in comparative table 35 row 18 but no current-period interest rate in table 11 row 13, and Parts Town has 1.75 PIK in comparative table 37 row 38 but its current-period row at table 13 row 38 shows 8.45 percent and S + 4.75 percent with no PIK. Thus the published text-derived values for the 2026-03-31 rows are comparative-period leakage, not valid current-period values.
